name: Signs Of Life
detailed_description:
Signs of Life is a non-linear, surreal story driven adventure game.

You are thrown into a bizarre scenario: a small woman with a mask is asking for your help to investigate a disembodied head she found in the backyard's hedge maze. Who is friend, who is foe, and how did we end up here? Play to find out.

Features

Non-linear story driven adventure game.
Unique hand drawn 2D Art-Style and 2D animation with customizable character.
Explore and click around to solve puzzles, play mini-games, and find objects including:
  • Journal entries
  • Books
  • Objects to complete quests
  • Slide puzzle
  • Rhythm game
Interactive objects to discover along your journey, such as singing flowers and a moon that talks back.
Original Soundtrack by Caleb Jordahl.

short_description: A meditative, non-combative point-and-click mystery set in a surreal, stop-motion inspired world. Explore dreamlike environments, uncover hidden objects, and piece together quiet clues to unravel fragments of forgotten meaning. Designed for players seeking a thoughtful, atmospheric experience.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains surreal and symbolic content that may not be suitable for all audiences. It includes stylized nudity (no genitalia), suggestive humor, unsettling body imagery (such as disembodied figures and self-surgery involving limbs), depictions of a character consuming a baby, references to drug-like experiences, and a storybook sequence with sexually themed and crude language.

Please note: the game does not depict or glamorize sexual assault, suicide, or drug use, but it may touch on emotionally intense topics such as grief, isolation, and bodily transformation through symbolic or narrative means.
